sections.title: Purpose
sections.content: This Agreement is entered into for the purpose of protecting confidential information exchanged during executive interview coaching and career advisory services.

sections.title: Definition of Confidential Information
sections.content: "Confidential Information" includes, but is not limited to: (a) Client's current employment status, job title, and employer; (b) Client's career goals, target companies, and interview timeline; (c) Compensation details, both current and target; (d) Interview feedback, preparation materials, and coaching session content; (e) Any personal or professional information shared during coaching sessions.

sections.title: Obligations of Receiving Party
sections.content: Each party agrees to: (a) Keep all Confidential Information strictly confidential; (b) Not disclose any Confidential Information to third parties without prior written consent; (c) Use Confidential Information solely for the purpose of the coaching engagement; (d) Take reasonable measures to protect the confidentiality of the information.

sections.title: Exclusions
sections.content: Confidential Information does not include information that: (a) Is or becomes publicly available through no fault of the receiving party; (b) Was rightfully in the receiving party's possession before disclosure; (c) Is independently developed without use of Confidential Information; (d) Is required to be disclosed by law or court order.

sections.title: Term
sections.content: This Agreement shall remain in effect for a period of two (2) years from the date of last disclosure of Confidential Information, or until the coaching relationship ends, whichever is later.

sections.title: No Testimonials Without Consent
sections.content: Coach agrees not to use Client's name, likeness, company name, or any identifying information in marketing materials, case studies, or testimonials without Client's explicit written consent.

sections.title: Data Deletion
sections.content: Upon Client's written request, Coach agrees to permanently delete all notes, communications, and records related to the coaching engagement within 30 days.

sections.title: Governing Law
sections.content: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of New Jersey, United States.

requestInfo.title: Request NDA Template
requestInfo.description: Request the mutual NDA template via WhatsApp or email. Rupesh will personally send you the document for review and signing.
requestInfo.note: NDAs are handled personally to ensure proper customization and legal compliance.
